question: Should Workspaces permanently expose `builtin:preview` as a distinct saved widget kind, or should preview controls extend the existing `builtin:iframe-embed` contract?
rationale: Both designs are technically possible, but choosing a persisted widget identity is a long-lived product and compatibility decision that automation cannot safely make.

options.title: Consolidate before merge
options.body: Extend the existing iframe widget with typed optional preview controls so saved workspaces retain one URL-embed contract.

options.title: Sponsor a distinct kind
options.body: Approve `builtin:preview` as a permanent separate contract and require focused compatibility tests, renderer fixes, and current-head proof.

options.title: Defer the preview tier
options.body: Keep the existing iframe widget unchanged and pause this PR until later browser or dev-server capabilities justify a distinct builtin.

recommendation.title: Consolidate before merge
recommendation.body: Extend the existing iframe widget with typed optional preview controls so saved workspaces retain one URL-embed contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Workspaces integration and widget contract entered main through their merged implementation.
